renderer.inputs: 1 or 12 results across three dictionaries; eight senses per dictionary; three named frequency sources; pitch position 2; link, Anki and link custom actions all labelled Custom button; popup 560 x 420; grouped case explicitly selects the first dictionary, showing 12 of 36 blocks.

hover.boundary: Production extension, MV3 worker and WASM path through first visible result and two stable frames; compact summaries enabled; no configured custom buttons.

limits: Synthetic public fixtures, not a large installed dictionary library.
Shared desktop without CPU isolation. Alternating iteration order retains every measured sample and profile load.
Hidden-group glossaries and action sets are still fully constructed; no work is deferred beyond the measured renderer interval.

Final initial-render medians rise by 0.1 ms, 0.7 ms and 0.5 ms for 3 blocks, 36 visible blocks and 36 blocks with 12 visible. The 3-block and 36-visible paired medians rise in all six profiles. This is remaining header/action layout cost, not an initial speedup.
Warm end-to-end hover is not a claimed speedup. Final hover has three fresh profiles per revision and 72 warm lookups; cold has only three samples per revision.
Zero-millisecond presentation medians reflect the observed 0.1 ms timer quantization, not an absence of work.

Intermediate diagnostic workloads use three custom links labelled Search, Sentence and More. The final workload uses link, Anki and link actions all labelled Custom button. Their timings and different harness boundaries are not pooled.

Mask suppression hides glyphs and is not a valid product optimization. The loaded label-reuse diagnostic includes an unrelated eight-way WASM compile burst. All measured samples from indexed runs remain, including stalls.
